No. S94

BRUNEI NATIONAL PETROLEUM COMPANY SENDIRIAN BERHAD

ORDER, 2002 {S 6/02)

NOTICE ON THE GRANTING OF MINERAL RIGHTS BY

HIS MAJESTY THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN IN COUNCIL (section 3(lll It is hereby notified that His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council has, on the 9th. September, 2010 pursuant to section 311! of the Brunei National Petroleum Company Sendirian Berhad Order, 2002, granted all mineral rights to the Brunei National Petroleum Company Sendirian Berhad within the designated area referred to as Block P having the following co-ordinates Point Latitude {N} Longitude {E} I P1-11 555000.00 470000.00 I P1-13 550000.00 467500.00 I I P1-17 545045.00 474902.00 i P1-18 542697.84 464411.27 I. P1-19 555422.16 451183.63 i P1-20 561033.96 444319.53 i P1-22 565000.00 445000.00

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE I P2-04 572500.00 487500.00 I P2-09 574490.92 483716.45 i P3-ll 534000.00 495909.40 P3·20 542500.00 495000.00 I i I P3-32 558175.00 506716.00 I P3-34 552556.00 497824.00 ' ' P3-43 566181.00 521500.00 i Dated this 6th. day of Zulkaedah, 1431 Hijriah corresponding to the 14th. day of October, 2010.

PEHIN ORANG KAYA PEKERMA JAYA

DATO PADUKA HAJI JUDIN BIN HAJI ASAR Secretary to the Council of Ministers.
